agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipeDiagno.en: Refine per-scene emotion and visual intent in the director plan before splitting the storyboard table.
agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipeDiagno.zh: 当前更建议先细化导演计划里的分场景情绪/画面意图，再继续拆分分镜表。

agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipeDiagno.en: Expand the key storyboard table window first, then decide whether to advance storyboard frames.
agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipeDiagno.zh: 当前更建议先扩读关键分镜表窗口，再决定是否推进 storyboard。

agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipeDiagno.en: Follow the first suggestion card and prioritize the cheapest next action.
agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipeDiagno.zh: 当前建议按第一张卡开始推进，优先执行最靠前的低成本动作。

agentWorkspaceProductionSupervisionSumma.en: Continue based on the latest review conclusion.

agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipeSbGenR.en: Storyboard generation ran; refresh storyboard results before deciding whether to write back.
agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipeSbGenR.zh: 分镜生成动作已执行，先刷新分镜结果，再决定是否写回。

agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipeContin.en: If storyboard results are still unstable, return to scriptPlan for another director decision round.
agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipeContin.zh: 如分镜结果还不稳定，回到 scriptPlan 生成下一轮导演决策。

agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipeSbTabl.en: The storyboard-table sub-agent ran; refresh the table before deciding whether to revise further.
agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipeSbTabl.zh: 分镜表子代理已执行，先刷新分镜表，再决定是否继续修订。

agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipeSbTabl.en: When needed, switch to storyboard to confirm table changes have propagated to rendered frames.
agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipeSbTabl.zh: 必要时切回 storyboard，确认分镜表调整是否已经落实到画面结果。

agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipeAssets.en: An asset action ran; refresh asset results before deciding whether to write back.
agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipeAssets.zh: 资产动作已执行，先刷新资产结果，再决定是否写回。

agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipeAssets.en: If materials are still missing, chain the asset sub-agent for another generation round.
agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipeAssets.zh: 若仍缺素材，可直接衔接资产子代理推进下一轮生成。

agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipeAssets.en: Assets are empty; let the sub-agent fill in derived material planning first.
agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipeAssets.zh: 当前 assets 为空，优先让子代理补齐衍生素材规划。

agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipeAssets.en: Given the current empty assets flow, plan a minimal viable derived material set and explain priorities.
agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipeAssets.zh: 请基于当前空白 assets flow 规划最小可行的衍生素材集合，并说明优先级。

agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipeAssets.en: Some materials still lack rendered images; run the asset generation sub-agent directly.
agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipeAssets.zh: 仍有素材缺少图像结果，适合直接运行素材生成子代理。

agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipeRefres.en: After closing asset gaps, revisit storyboard to see whether the current approach still fits.
agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipeRefres.zh: 素材缺口补齐后通常需要回看 storyboard 是否还能沿用当前方案。

agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipeCheckS.en: Assets have baseline results; switch to storyboard to assess frame generation status.
agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipeCheckS.zh: 资产已具备基础结果，可切到 storyboard 评估镜头生成状态。

agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipeTidyDi.en: If materials are mostly ready, generate the next director plan round to close out production pacing.
agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipeTidyDi.zh: 若素材已基本齐全，可生成下一轮导演计划收束 production 节奏。

agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipeTidyDi.en: Combine current material status with scriptPlan and output the next director plan with execution priorities.
agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipeTidyDi.zh: 请结合现有素材状态与 scriptPlan，输出下一轮导演计划与执行优先级。

agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipeFirstS.en: Storyboard is empty; run the storyboard generation sub-agent to establish an initial shot set.
agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipeFirstS.zh: 当前 storyboard 为空，优先运行分镜生成子代理建立初版镜头。

agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipeFirstS.en: Generate a first-pass storyboard from the current production context with a minimal viable shot set.
agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipeFirstS.zh: 请基于当前 production 上下文生成第一版 storyboard，并保持最小可行镜头集。

agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipeVerify.en: Focus on assets referenced by the current storyboard window to avoid unrelated material in frame fills.
agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipeVerify.zh: 优先只看当前分镜窗口实际引用的资产，避免把无关素材带入分镜补图。

agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipeVerify.en: The storyboard digest has not resolved explicit asset IDs; fall back to a compact assets summary read.
agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipeVerify.zh: 当前分镜摘要尚未定位出明确资产 ID，退回紧凑 assets 摘要读取。

agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipeCheckS.en: When needed, review the structured storyboardTable before writeback.
agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipeCheckS.zh: 必要时切到 storyboardTable 审阅结构化镜头表后再回写。

agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipeVerify.en: Storyboard references explicit assets; verify this set is enough for upcoming director adjustments.
agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipeVerify.zh: 分镜已引用明确资产，可先核对这批资产是否足够支撑后续导演调整。

agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipeVerify.en: The storyboard digest did not resolve explicit asset IDs; read the compact assets summary first.
agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipeVerify.zh: 当前分镜摘要未定位出明确资产 ID，先读紧凑 assets 摘要即可。

agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipeRefres.en: Storyboard has baseline results; return to scriptPlan to organize the next director decision round.
agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipeRefres.zh: 分镜已有基础结果，适合回到 scriptPlan 整理下一轮导演决策。

agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipeCreate.en: scriptPlan is empty; establish a director plan before advancing assets or storyboard.
agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipeCreate.zh: 当前 scriptPlan 为空，优先建立导演计划再推进资产或分镜。

agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipeCreate.en: Generate a director plan from the current production context with execution priorities.
agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipeCreate.zh: 请基于当前 production 上下文生成一版导演计划，并给出执行优先级。

agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipeReview.en: The director plan has content; a supervision review first surfaces pacing and asset issues cheaply.
agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipeReview.zh: 导演计划已有内容，先做一次监督审核更容易在低成本阶段发现节奏和资产问题。

agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipeReview.en: Review the current director plan for plot coverage, asset fit, and pacing.
agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipeReview.zh: 请审核当前导演规划，重点检查剧情覆盖、资产匹配与节奏合理性。

agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipeRefine.en: The director plan still lacks clear per-scene emotion and visual intent; strengthen this before splitting storyboardTable to reduce rework.
agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipeRefine.zh: 当前导演计划还缺少足够明确的分场景情绪/画面意图，先补这层再拆 storyboardTable，能减少后续反复返工。

agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipePrevie.en: If the plan is stable, sample-check storyboardTable structure for fewer tokens before reading storyboard imagery.
agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipePrevie.zh: 如计划已定，先抽样检查 storyboardTable 结构更省 token，再决定是否读取 storyboard 画面结果。

agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipeRefine.en: Continue refining scriptPlan: prioritize per-scene emotional progression, visual intent, and shot anchors before storyboardTable split.
agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipeRefine.zh: 请继续细化当前 scriptPlan，优先补足分场景情绪推进、画面意图与镜头落点，再进入 storyboardTable 拆分。

agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipeCreate.en: storyboardTable is empty; use the storyboard-table sub-agent to add structure first.
agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipeCreate.zh: 当前 storyboardTable 为空，适合先用分镜表子代理补结构。

agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipeCreate.en: Produce a structured storyboardTable with fields that are clear and writeback-friendly.
agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipeCreate.zh: 请先产出结构化 storyboardTable，并保持字段清晰可回写。

agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipeReview.en: The table has content; supervision review first prevents bad structure from amplifying into storyboard.
agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipeReview.zh: 分镜表已有内容，先做监督审核可避免把错误结构继续放大到 storyboard。

agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipeReview.en: Review the current storyboard table for coverage, asset links, and split granularity.
agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipeReview.zh: 请审核当前分镜表，重点检查覆盖度、资产关联与拆分粒度。

agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipeVerify.en: Focus on assets referenced by the current storyboard window to reduce unrelated context.
agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipeVerify.zh: 优先只看当前分镜窗口实际引用的资产，减少无关素材上下文。

agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipeVerify.en: This window did not resolve linked asset IDs; fall back to a compact assets summary read.
agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipeVerify.zh: 当前窗口暂未解析出关联资产 ID，退回紧凑 assets 摘要读取。

agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipeSwitch.en: The table has content; continue checking whether storyboard imagery has caught up.
agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipeSwitch.zh: 分镜表已有内容，可继续查看 storyboard 画面结果是否跟上。

agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipeSample.en: Read the first 8 key columns first—usually enough to decide whether to keep reviewing or write back.
agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipeSample.zh: 先只看前 8 行关键列，通常足够判断是否继续审核或回写。

agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipeRechec.en: Director plans often stall on asset prep; reading assets first reduces rework.
agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipeRechec.zh: 导演计划常先卡在资产准备，先看 assets 能减少返工。

agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipeReread.en: After asset checks, return to a compact scriptPlan to see whether more revisions are needed before storyboard.
agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipeReread.zh: 资产核对后回到精简 scriptPlan，确认是否还需要修订计划再推进分镜。

agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipeCompar.en: Reread the key-column window first to avoid reloading the entire table into context.
agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipeCompar.zh: 先复读关键列窗口，避免把整张分镜表重新带入上下文。

agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipeReread.en: When needed, reread a compact script window to confirm shot rationale.
agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipeReread.zh: 需要时再回看紧凑剧本窗口，确认镜头依据。

agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipeSample.en: Read the key-column window first to avoid repeatedly loading the full table into context.
agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipeSample.zh: 先读取关键列窗口，避免把整张表反复带入上下文。

agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipeSample.en: Reread only the storyboard table rows for the focused shots from review; avoid returning to the full table window.
agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipeSample.zh: 先只复读审核聚焦镜头对应的分镜表行，避免回到整表窗口。

agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipeCompar.en: Before filling frames, reread the key-column window to avoid rebuilding context for every shot.
agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipeCompar.zh: 补图前先复读关键列窗口，避免为整批镜头重建上下文。

agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipeAssets.en: First review results for assets just generated, then decide whether to rerun.
agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipeAssets.zh: 先检查本次刚生成资产的结果再决定是否补跑

agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipeSbGenR.en: Storyboard generation ran; first reread missing-frame status for shots #{ids}.
agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipeSbGenR.zh: 分镜生成动作已执行，先回读本次镜头 #{ids} 的缺帧状态。

agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipeSbTabl.en: The storyboard-table sub-agent ran; first reread table rows for shots #{ids}.
agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipeSbTabl.zh: 分镜表子代理已执行，先回读本次镜头 #{ids} 对应的局部分镜表行。

agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipeSbTabl.en: Prefer rereading storyboard results for shots #{ids} only so a table tweak does not widen to the whole sequence.
agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipeSbTabl.zh: 优先只回读镜头 #{ids} 的 storyboard 结果，确认表格修改没有放大到整段。

agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipeAssets.en: Asset generation ran; first reread latest status for assets #{ids}.
agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipeAssets.zh: 资产生成动作已执行，先回读本次资产 #{ids} 的最新状态。

agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipeAssets.en: {scope} still lack images; prioritize patching only this derived set to save tokens.
agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipeAssets.zh: {scope} 仍缺图，优先只补这批衍生资产更省 token。

agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipeSbFill.en: Prioritize filling missing frames for shots #{idsLabel}{idTail}; avoid rerunning completed shots in bulk.
agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipeSbFill.zh: 优先只补缺帧镜头 #{idsLabel}{idTail}，避免把已完成镜头整批重跑。

agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipeReread.en: Reread only {scriptWindow} first to align the director plan with the script pacing before expanding reads.
agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipeReread.zh: 先只回看{scriptWindow}，确认导演计划与原文节奏一致，再决定是否扩读。

agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipeCheckK.en: The director plan calls out {assetScope}; verify precisely before expanding to other materials.
agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipeCheckK.zh: 导演计划已点名{assetScope}，先精确核对再决定是否扩读其他素材。

agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipeCheckK.en: The director plan has content; verify whether {assetScope} supports execution, then add more assets only if needed.
agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipeCheckK.zh: 导演计划已有内容，先核对{assetScope}是否支撑执行，信息不足时再补更多资产。

agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipeContin.en: Focus director decisions around {assetScope} so downstream storyboard and asset actions inherit these rewrite constraints first.
agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipeContin.zh: 优先围绕{assetScope}收束导演决策，让后续分镜和素材动作先继承这批受改写约束的重点。

agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipeContin.en: Continue tightening director decisions around {assetScope} so downstream storyboard and asset actions inherit the current rewrite constraints.
agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipeContin.zh: 先围绕{assetScope}继续收束导演决策，让后续分镜和素材动作继承当前改写约束。

agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipeContin.en: Continue tightening scriptPlan around {assetScope} for shot and material priorities so downstream storyboard execution inherits upstream rewrite constraints.
agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipeContin.zh: 请在当前 scriptPlan 上继续收束导演计划，优先围绕{assetScope}安排镜头和素材优先级，确保后续分镜执行继承上游改写约束。

agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipeContin.en: Continue tightening scriptPlan around {assetScope} for shot and material priorities so downstream storyboard execution inherits upstream rewrite constraints.
agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipeContin.zh: 请在当前 scriptPlan 上继续收束导演计划，优先围绕{assetScope}安排镜头和素材优先级，确保后续分镜执行继承上游改写约束。

agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipeReread.en: Before revising, reread only {scriptWindow} to avoid loading the entire script for scriptPlan.
agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipeReread.zh: 修订前先只回看{scriptWindow}，避免为 scriptPlan 扩读整段剧本。

agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipeRevise.en: Revise scriptPlan based on the latest review; prioritize fixing: {summary}
agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipeRevise.zh: 请根据最近审核意见修订 scriptPlan，优先解决：{summary}

agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipeVerify.en: Review conclusion: {summary}; first narrow to {assetScope} to confirm gaps in the director plan.
agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipeVerify.zh: 审核结论：{summary}；优先只看{assetScope}，确认导演计划缺口。

agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipeCompar.en: Prefer rereading only the storyboard table rows for {storyboardFocus} to avoid returning to the full table.
agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipeCompar.zh: 优先只复读{storyboardFocus}对应的分镜表行，避免退回整表。

agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipeReread.en: If shot rationale must be checked, prefer only the partial range: {reviewScope}.
agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipeReread.zh: 如需核对镜头依据，优先只用局部范围：{reviewScope}。

agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipeInspec.en: Review conclusion: {summary}; prefer only the partial range: {reviewScope}.
agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipeInspec.zh: 审核结论：{summary}；优先只用局部范围：{reviewScope}。

agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipeSwitch.en: Prefer rereading only the {count} shots covered by the current storyboard table window; avoid falling back to a generic storyboard digest.
agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipeSwitch.zh: 优先只回看当前分镜表窗口对应的 {count} 个镜头，避免退回通用分镜摘要。

agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipeCompar.en: Before filling frames, reread only the storyboard table rows for {storyboardFocus}.
agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipeCompar.zh: 补图前先只复读{storyboardFocus}对应的分镜表行。

agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipePrompt.en: Revise storyboardTable based on the latest review. {body}
agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipePrompt.zh: 请根据最近审核意见修订 storyboardTable。{body}

agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipePrompt.en: Continue advancing storyboard based on the latest review conclusion. {body}
agentWorkspaceProductionFlowRecipePrompt.zh: 请基于最近审核结论继续推进 storyboard。{body}

agentWorkspaceProductionAssetReviewPromp.en: Please verify only these {count} assets against the current director plan; fill only necessary gaps and avoid bulk-reading unrelated assets.{priority}
agentWorkspaceProductionAssetReviewPromp.zh: 请优先只核对这 {count} 个资产是否支撑当前导演规划；仅补必要缺口，不扩读无关素材。{priority}

agentWorkspaceProductionAssetReviewPromp.en: Please verify whether {scope} supports the current director plan; add minimal reads only if information is insufficient—do not bulk-read assets.{priority}
agentWorkspaceProductionAssetReviewPromp.zh: 请先核对{scope}是否支撑当前导演规划；信息不足时再最小补读，不要整包扩读 assets。{priority}

agentWorkspaceProductionRecipeAppliedFol.en: Applied suggestion: {title}. Next, refine the director plan.
agentWorkspaceProductionRecipeAppliedFol.zh: 已应用任务建议：{title}，下一步先细化导演计划。

agentWorkspaceProductionRecipeAppliedFol.en: Applied suggestion: {title}. Next, expand the key storyboard table window.
agentWorkspaceProductionRecipeAppliedFol.zh: 已应用任务建议：{title}，下一步先扩读关键分镜表窗口。
